SELECT name, company, priority, notes, language,
  EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW() - next_followup_at)::int AS overdue_days,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    ORDER BY CASE priority WHEN 'A' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 2 WHEN 'C' THEN 3 WHEN 'D' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,
      next_followup_at ASC
  )::int AS rn
FROM jonas_leads
WHERE tenant_id = '{{ $('Aktive Tenants laden').item.json.tenant_id.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
  AND next_followup_at IS NOT NULL
  AND next_followup_at <= NOW()
ORDER BY rn ASC
LIMIT 20
